name: motionfold
baseline: A deck of polished UI transitions for every stack — accessible by default, tunable in one line.

families.surface: A layer that opens over the page and later leaves.
families.state: A control or region that changes state in place.
families.feedback: A short confirmation or correction after an action.
families.navigation: A move between two views of the same level.

recipes.title: Modal
recipes.when: A blocking decision or a short focused task that needs the page to wait.
recipes.notWhen: A non-blocking confirmation (use toast) or a contextual menu (use popover).

recipes.title: Drawer
recipes.when: A side panel for navigation, filters, or details that keeps the page in context.
recipes.notWhen: A short menu (use popover) or a centered blocking task (use modal).

recipes.title: Popover
recipes.when: A contextual menu or action panel anchored to a trigger.
recipes.notWhen: A blocking decision (use modal) or the main navigation.

recipes.title: Tooltip
recipes.when: A short hint that complements a control on hover or keyboard focus.
recipes.notWhen: Essential information, long text, or a touch-only target.

recipes.title: Toast
recipes.when: A transient confirmation of an asynchronous action.
recipes.notWhen: An error that needs a decision or information that must persist.

recipes.title: Accordion
recipes.when: A header reveals a body in a constrained space: settings groups, FAQs, show more.
recipes.notWhen: Primary navigation or content that should stay visible.

recipes.title: Tabs
recipes.when: Peer views switch in place with a shared moving indicator.

recipes.title: Switch
recipes.when: A boolean setting that applies immediately.
recipes.notWhen: A form choice that is submitted later (use a checkbox or radio group).

recipes.title: Checkbox
recipes.when: Multiple selection or consent inside a form.
recipes.notWhen: An instant setting (use switch) or a single exclusive choice (use radios).

recipes.title: Skeleton
recipes.when: Content is loading and its structure is already known.
recipes.notWhen: The wait is very short or the final layout is unknown.

recipes.title: Success check
recipes.when: An action just completed and the moment is worth confirming.
recipes.notWhen: A passive status change or a signal without any text.

recipes.title: Error shake
recipes.when: A form submission failed validation and the field needs attention.
recipes.notWhen: A system failure, an already announced error, or a whole form.

recipes.title: Text swap
recipes.when: A short status label changes in place and the change matters.
recipes.notWhen: Long paragraphs or the main content of a view.

recipes.title: Page slide
recipes.when: Moving between two views of the same level: list to detail, step to step.
recipes.notWhen: Very frequent keyboard navigation or an unsupported browser with no fallback.
